body: Emmanuel keeps its Patronal Festival at Corpus Christi — the feast of the Body of Christ, and of "God with us," the name our church carries.

We begin with a special Sung Mass at 10:30, after which everyone is warmly invited to stay for a Bring & Share BBQ. Bring a side, a dessert or a soft drink to share — and a picnic blanket for the garden.
The festival closes with Choral Evensong at 6:30pm, sung by our parish choir.
